files.content:
---
title: Send, wait 5 days, remind again, and copy the CRA from the second reminder
performer: system
strictness: strict
reads: [case.site, case.email_to, case.email_cc, case.email_subject, case.email_body]
tools:
  allowed:  [etmf.reminder.create]
  required: [etmf.reminder.create]
map:
  etmf.reminder.create:
    site:    case.site
    sent_to: case.email_to
    copied:  case.email_cc
    subject: case.email_subject
    body:    case.email_body
    sent_at: { now: true }
outcomes: [sent]
---
Send the approved reminder to the site and keep it on the site's record, so the next round knows how
many reminders came before. Then the site has 5 days to upload; the next reminder goes out unless
the start-up pack is complete by then.

input.summary: Copy the CRA on the reminder from the second one on

reply:
Done: from the second reminder on, the reminder is sent to the site coordinator **and copies the site's CRA**. eTMF is regulated, so this isn't a study's own copy: it's change request **CR-001** for the whole eTMF app (every study's reminders), and the live playbook hasn't changed.

I ran the draft on **site 101** in a throwaway copy: it found 2 missing documents, drafted the reminder to Owen Price, and would record it as sent, copying Priya Shah (the CRA). Nothing was sent.

When you're happy with it, open **CR-001** on the page and send it to QA; it goes live when QA signs it.

files.content:
---
title: Send the reminders to each site's study coordinator
performer: system
strictness: strict
reads: [case.reminders]
tools:
  allowed:  [email.send]
  required: [email.send]
map:
  email.send:
    each:    case.reminders
    to:      item.to
    subject: item.subject
    body:    item.body
outcomes: [sent]
---
Email each site's coordinator their reminder. Every email is outgoing, so each one waits for a
person to approve its exact text first.

input.summary: Name who gets the reminders in the send step

reply:
Done: the send step now says who gets the reminders: **each site's study coordinator**, as Rave names them. It's a draft of **Study MW-207's own copy** of the playbook in EDC; the live copy hasn't changed, and Study MW-301 keeps its own.

When you're happy with it, use **Send for review** on the page.
3 of Study MW-301's sites still owe documents: **109** (6 missing), **101** (2) and **110** (1). The list beside this chat now shows just those three; save it as a page to keep it.

The test run copied site 101, its study and its expected documents into a throwaway database and replayed the latest reminder run's model turns. It stopped at **Wait for the upload**, where the next reminder waits 5 days.
Ask me to change the playbook, or to filter the list, and I'll do it here.
